title: Cross-Reference with Access Keys
description: Compare the access key used in the unauthorized activity with others to assess credential risk.
recommended_next_focus: Assess the overall risk associated with the compromised credentials

title: Review Additional IAM Activity Logs
description: Search for similar IAM activities to pinpoint the origin of the unauthorized access attempt.
recommended_next_focus: Identify further unauthorized activities and their sources

title: Monitor Logging for Future Incidents
description: Set up alerts for future logging attempts to prevent similar incidents in the future.
recommended_next_focus: Implement continuous monitoring and alerting for logging activities
